correctness.rationale: Definitions fix the lattice and the toric fan. Every primitive vertex is a coordinate permutation with zero orbit sum; a Demazure root would have one −1 and one +1 pairing. The exact permutation tight-frame inequality forces at least R/n nonzero pairings, excluding roots for R>2n. The simplex endpoint is excluded by congruence modulo n+1, and the single six-vertex exception by explicit even pairing. Polarity and uniqueness of the relation among coordinate normal classes force fan symmetries to be coordinate permutations with a global inversion only at A=B. Complete toric automorphism theory gives the semidirect-product group. Exact sample script corroborates cardinality and frame identities.

value.rationale: The new toric alpha-spectrum construction yields every rational alpha value in a sharp interval. The complete all-parameter automorphism calculation determines stabilizers (identity component and components) for these natural realizations. The symmetric-box point has twice the discrete symmetry, and the singular simplex endpoint has torus-only connected automorphisms despite its simplex fan. These are meaningful structural distinctions not reducible to an arbitrary small numerical calculation.
